prompt_only.recipe_name: Steamed Chicken and Carrot Rice Bowl
steps: Dice the chicken and carrots into small, uniform cubes.
Boil or steam the rice in water until fully cooked.
Steam or boil the chicken cubes and carrots until the chicken is cooked through and the carrots are tender.
Combine the cooked chicken, carrots, and rice in a bowl and serve warm.
prompt_only.message: Recipe tailored for diabetes management by using a controlled portion of rice balanced with lean chicken protein and fibrous carrots.

rag_assisted.recipe_name: Steamed Chicken and Carrot Rice Bowl
steps: Rinse the rice and boil in water until fully cooked and tender.
Dice the chicken into bite-sized pieces and slice the carrot into rounds.
Steam the chicken pieces and carrot slices together until the chicken is cooked through and the carrots are fork-tender.
Transfer the cooked rice to a bowl and top with the steamed chicken and carrots before serving.
rag_assisted.message: Portion-controlled rice is paired with lean chicken protein and fibrous carrots to promote balanced blood glucose levels in accordance with diabetic dietary guidance.
